text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With all of Symboli Rudolf's races<n>over, now is as
good a time as any to<n>reflect on her achievements.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Judging purely by number of<n>accolades, my record
is not as<n>incontestable as I might have hoped.
choice_data_list: But everyone still knows you're the Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's... kind of you to say.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I have achieved that much, I can call<n>my imperial
campaign a success.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
These victories will fuel me to pursue<n>even greater
feats.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: As did you, Trainer. Thank you.
